title: Weak cosmic censorship, trapped surfaces, and naked singularities for the Einstein vacuum equations
evidence_excerpt: The weak cosmic censorship conjecture posits that, generically, all singularities in General Relativity arising from regular asymptotically flat initial data should have a complete future null infinity. While this conjecture remains wide open, it has inspired many mathematical works concerning topics such as trapped surface formation and the construction of naked singularities.
